The '''Tocco system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was part of the [[Melantha Province]], situated near the [[Lupani system/Legends|Lupani]] and [[Ricaldi system/Legends|Ricaldi systems]].
